foreground waits for the command to finish before continuing; background runs a session-owned job in the background and Evener stops it when the session ends; detached is the only mode that lets a process survive after this Evener session stops — a detached process is not a job: its output is discarded (redirect it to an absolute path the process may write) and it sends no completion notification. A detached command gets no session scratch: $EVENER_SCRATCH_DIR is unset there, so no path it reads or writes may be built from it.
